purpose: Teach: 陶器/アミノ酸/音符/管弦楽/画素/サンダル/ギタリスト/リアクション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が陶器のカップを褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer just complimented the ceramic cups, Mei.
lines.style: Warm, gentle mention. Light rise on 'complimented' like sharing a small good thing. Relaxed pace. Eye contact soft, offering the moment to Mei.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アミノ酸の研究のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Turns out that customer does amino acid research, Mei.
lines.style: Thoughtful tone. Slight pause before 'amino acid' — genuinely processing this detail about them. Conversational, not rushing. Soft curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のBGMの音符が一拍ずれてるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, the background music here — one of the notes is off by a beat.
lines.style: Observant, almost murmuring the realization. Tilts head slightly. Not critical — more like noticing something delicate has shifted. Gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、管弦楽団の方なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's actually with an orchestra, can you believe that?
lines.style: Surprised appreciation in the opening. Light emphasis on 'orchestra'. Warm, connecting-the-dots feeling. Sharing wonder with Mei naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のカメラ、画素を上げたい所ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The camera in here really could use better resolution, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle observation, not complaint. Thoughtful pause before the question. Looking around the space like noticing something she's been meaning to mention. Soft, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、夏の制服にサンダルOKかしら、メイちゃん
lines.en: I wonder if we're allowed to wear sandals with the summer uniform?
lines.style: Curious, genuine uncertainty. Slight lift at the question. Not anxious — just thinking out loud to Mei. Conversational, wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ギタリストなんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh — and that customer's a guitarist, apparently.
lines.style: Delighted recognition, like another piece clicks into place. Light spark of connection in the voice. Sharing it like it matters that Mei knows too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにお客様のリアクション良かったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer's reaction to the new menu item was really good.
lines.style: Satisfied, genuine happiness in the words. Closing warmth — like sharing a small win. Slight pause of contentment before the natural endpoint.
